findings.title: r1 W4 fix is wrong for production data: the chronological sort compares mixed timestamp formats, so a same-day form-open renders ABOVE the invitation
findings.evidence: client: |> list.sort(fn(a, b) { string.compare(a.at, b.at) }) with comment 'All `at` values are UTC ISO strings (RFC3339 from the sweep, PG `::text` for form_opened_at) — lexical sort is chronological.' / server SQL: COALESCE(form_opened_at::text, '') — PG ::text renders '2026-08-01 21:12:00+00' (space at index 10) / attempts: sweep.gleam now_iso() = to_rfc3339 -> '2026-08-01T10:04:00Z' ('T' at index 10) / integration pin: "form_opened_at":"2026-08-01 21:12:00+00" / pin test feeds form_opened_at: Some("2026-08-03T18:00:00Z") — the format the server never sends
findings.detail: Lexically ' ' (0x20) < 'T' (0x54), so a same-day form-open (the §7.2 canonical case: invite Tue 10:04, opened Tue 21:12) sorts BEFORE the invitation — inverted. The pin test feeds RFC3339 the server never sends (integration pins the space form), so the suite stays green while production inverts.
findings.recommended_fix: Normalize both sides before comparing (replace ' ' with 'T' on the PG values, or compare via a parsed timestamp), and pin the test with the real PG space-format wire value.

findings.title: B1's hook-driven sub-line has no distinguishing test: a revert to status-derived terminality (r1's exact bug, omitting v2 Completed) would pass everything
findings.location: client/test/components/reference_panel_test.gleam:47-51 (fixture derives hooks from client's own is_terminal_status)
findings.evidence: hooks: reference_call.ReferenceCallHooks(can_record_manual: !is_terminal_status(status), ...) — the fixture mirrors the same rule the code uses, so a status-set regression (e.g. Completed omitted) with hooks derived from the same set can't be caught; all_terminal_subline_test uses FormCompleted only
findings.detail: The mechanism is pinned via FormCompleted, but no fixture drives a hook/status disagreement (e.g. v2 Completed row with can_record_manual=false -> 'All references closed'). A revert to the r1 status-derived is_terminal passes.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a fixture where status=Completed (v2) + hooks.can_record_manual=false and assert the all-terminal sub-line.

findings.title: W6 landed but inert: refcheck_explainer_dismissed is persisted + hydrated but never consumed by any view or update

findings.detail: The localStorage mechanism now exists per the PR spec, but the persisted flag has zero observable effect — behavior is identical with or without it. Harmless dead state, but the 'per-user dismissed state' is still effectively session-scoped.
findings.recommended_fix: Consume the hydrated flag (e.g. seed explainer_open from it on first render) or document why the flag is vestigial.

findings.title: N2 fix partial: normalize_datetime swaps the space but the colon-less '+00' offset remains — still not a valid HTML datetime value
findings.evidence: fn normalize_datetime(at: String) -> String { string.replace(at, " ", "T") } — '2026-08-01 21:12:00+00' becomes '2026-08-01T21:12:00+00'; valid HTML datetime requires +00:00 or Z, not '+00'
findings.detail: r1 N2 said the colon-less offset is not valid HTML datetime; the fix normalizes the separator but leaves the offset form invalid. The formatter displays fine; the attribute is technically invalid.
findings.recommended_fix: Normalize to a fully valid form (append ':00' to the offset, or to_rfc3339-style conversion) and add a test.
